Kernel stores per-row loss but divides by n_non_ignore as if it were mean reduction, while returning per-row loss tensor. Contract says loss[i] = -log softmax per row. So the loss is also wrong — it's returning mean-normalized per-row loss. Hmm, but is that in-scope? The contract states loss[i] = -log softmax(logits[i])[target[i]].
